itens.descricao: Wraps a variadic list of middleware functions into a Middlewares slice that can build a handler chain around an endpoint.
itens.motivo: Chain(middlewares ...func(http.Handler) http.Handler) converts the variadic list to Middlewares. Handler and HandlerFunc then build the chain around an endpoint.

itens.descricao: Declares the public surface of the chi package, including the NewRouter constructor, the Router and Routes interfaces, and the Middlewares type.
itens.motivo: chi.go declares NewRouter (which calls NewMux), the Router and Routes interfaces, and the Middlewares type.

itens.descricao: Keeps route patterns, URL parameters and the routing path for a request in a Context object that can be read from the request context.
itens.motivo: Context holds RoutePatterns, URLParams and RoutePath. RouteContext reads it from the request context through RouteCtxKey.

itens.descricao: Rejects requests whose HTTP Basic credentials are missing or unknown, comparing the password with a constant-time check and answering 401 with a WWW-Authenticate challenge.
itens.motivo: Missing credentials or an unknown user are rejected. The password is compared with subtle.ConstantTimeCompare. Failure sets WWW-Authenticate and writes 401.

itens.descricao: Collapses repeated slashes in the routing path with path.Clean so that requests such as /users//1 are routed the same as /users/1.
itens.motivo: When rctx.RoutePath is empty, the middleware sets it to path.Clean of the URL path. That collapses duplicate slashes for routing.

itens.descricao: Stores the client IP taken from a trusted proxy header or remote address under a private context key, which GetClientIP reads back for handlers.
itens.motivo: The ClientIPFrom* middlewares take the IP from a trusted header, from XFF, or from RemoteAddr. They store it under the unexported clientIPCtxKey, and GetClientIP reads it back.

itens.descricao: Compresses response bodies of configured content types with the encoder matched from the Accept-Encoding request header, at a caller-given compression level.
itens.motivo: Compress(level, types...) builds a Compressor. selectEncoder picks the encoder from Accept-Encoding, and only allowed content types are compressed, at the given level.

itens.descricao: Answers 415 Unsupported Media Type when a request charset is outside the allowed list, while letting empty charsets and bodiless requests through.
itens.motivo: An empty charset is not let through unconditionally. It passes only if "" is in the allowed list, because the check is slices.Contains(charsets, params["charset"]). Without "" in the list, a request with no charset gets 415. Only bodiless requests (ContentLength == 0) are always allowed.

itens.descricao: Checks each Content-Encoding value of a request against an allowlist and returns 415 when any value is not permitted, skipping requests with no body.
itens.motivo: Every Content-Encoding header value is checked against the allowlist. Any value not in it gets 415. Requests with ContentLength == 0 skip the check.

itens.descricao: Sets a fixed response header through SetHeader and enforces a request Content-Type allowlist through AllowContentType, which answers 415 on mismatch.
itens.motivo: SetHeader sets a fixed response header. AllowContentType checks the request media type against a lowercase allowlist and responds 415 when it does not match.

itens.descricao: Marks a route as deprecated with RFC 9745 headers, panics on a zero date, and adds each supplied link as a Link header.
itens.motivo: It sets the Deprecation header in RFC 9745 form ("@" plus Unix seconds). It panics if deprecatedAt is zero, and it adds each link as a Link header.

itens.descricao: Sends HEAD requests to GET handlers when no HEAD route matches the routing path, using a temporary route context for the lookup.
itens.motivo: For HEAD requests it builds a temporary context with chi.NewRouteContext and calls Routes.Match for HEAD. If there is no match, it sets RouteMethod to GET so the GET handler serves the request.

itens.descricao: Answers GET and HEAD requests to a configured path with a 200 text/plain dot and skips the rest of the chain, for load balancer probes.
itens.motivo: Para GET ou HEAD com o caminho igual ao endpoint (EqualFold), define Content-Type text/plain, responde 200 com o corpo "." e retorna sem chamar o próximo handler. Qualquer outra requisição segue a cadeia.

itens.descricao: Logs each request once, when it completes, with its status, byte count and duration, using color only on a TTY and a pluggable LogFormatter.
itens.motivo: A cor não depende de o stdout ser um TTY. O init() só desliga a cor quando runtime.GOOS == "windows" e a liga em qualquer outro sistema, mesmo com saída redirecionada. Não há nenhuma detecção de TTY. O resto vale: o log é escrito uma vez no defer, com status, bytes e duração, e existe a interface LogFormatter.

itens.descricao: Applies a wrapped middleware only when a predicate on the request returns true, and passes every other request straight to the next handler.
itens.motivo: Maybe monta mw(next) e só chama o wrapped quando maybeFn(r) é true. Caso contrário chama next diretamente.
itens.trecho: if maybeFn(r) { wrapped.ServeHTTP(w, r) } else { next.ServeHTTP(w, r) }

itens.descricao: Turns a plain http.Handler into a middleware constructor that serves that handler in place of the next one, and defines the private contextKey type.
itens.motivo: New devolve um construtor de middleware que ignora next e serve h. O arquivo também define o tipo privado contextKey.
itens.trecho: return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { h.ServeHTTP(w, r) })

itens.descricao: Sets no-cache headers on the response and deletes ETag and conditional If-* headers from the incoming request.
itens.motivo: NoCache remove de r.Header ETag, If-Modified-Since, If-Match, If-None-Match, If-Range e If-Unmodified-Since. Depois define Expires, Cache-Control, Pragma e X-Accel-Expires na resposta.
itens.trecho: for _, v := range etagHeaders { if r.Header.Get(v) != "" { r.Header.Del(v) } }

itens.descricao: Serves a fixed handler for GET requests whose path matches case-insensitively, and passes all other requests on to the next middleware.
itens.motivo: Só atende quando o método é GET e o caminho é igual ao informado, ignorando maiúsculas e minúsculas (EqualFold). As demais requisições vão para next.

itens.descricao: Replaces the first occurrence of a substring in the request URL path with a new value before handing the request to the next handler.
itens.motivo: Usa strings.Replace com n=1 em r.URL.Path, substituindo só a primeira ocorrência, e depois chama next.

itens.descricao: Builds a chi subrouter that mounts net/http/pprof and expvar endpoints behind the NoCache middleware, meant to be mounted under a path such as /debug.
itens.motivo: Profiler cria um chi.NewRouter com r.Use(NoCache). Monta os handlers de pprof e expvar.Handler() em /vars. O comentário mostra o uso com r.Mount("/debug", ...).

itens.descricao: Deprecated middleware that rewrites r.RemoteAddr from True-Client-IP, X-Real-IP or X-Forwarded-For headers, leaving it open to IP spoofing.
itens.motivo: RealIP está marcado como Deprecated por vulnerabilidade a spoofing. Ele sobrescreve r.RemoteAddr com True-Client-IP, X-Real-IP ou X-Forwarded-For, nessa ordem, desde que o valor seja um IP válido.

itens.descricao: Recovers from handler panics, logs the stack trace and returns 500, but leaves http.ErrAbortHandler unrecovered so the client response is aborted.
itens.motivo: Recoverer captura o panic, registra a pilha pelo logEntry.Panic ou PrintPrettyStack e escreve 500, exceto em Upgrade. Se o valor for http.ErrAbortHandler, faz panic de novo para abortar a resposta.

itens.descricao: Reuses the X-Request-Id header when present, otherwise generates an ID from a prefix and an atomic counter, stored under RequestIDKey.
itens.motivo: Usa o cabeçalho RequestIDHeader (X-Request-Id) quando presente. Senão gera "prefix-%06d" com um contador atômico (reqid.Add(1)) e guarda o valor no contexto sob RequestIDKey.

itens.descricao: Limits the size of each request body by wrapping it in http.MaxBytesReader with the given byte count before calling the next handler.
itens.motivo: Troca r.Body por http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, bytes) antes de chamar o próximo handler.

itens.descricao: Picks which middleware stack handles a request by matching header values such as Host or Origin, and offers RouteDefault as a default branch.
itens.motivo: HeaderRouter maps lowercased header names to patterns plus middleware; Handler picks the first matching route's middleware, and RouteDefault sets the "*" fallback.

itens.descricao: Offers three path helpers: StripSlashes removes trailing slashes before routing, RedirectSlashes redirects to the slashless path, and StripPrefix removes a prefix.
itens.motivo: StripSlashes trims the trailing slash from RoutePath or URL.Path and continues. RedirectSlashes issues a 301 to the slashless path. StripPrefix wraps http.StripPrefix.

itens.descricao: Announces a route's removal date with RFC 8594 Sunset headers, panics on a zero date, and is meant to be kept alongside Deprecation on the same route.
itens.motivo: It sets the Sunset header in HTTP time format, adds Link headers, and panics if sunsetAt is zero. The doc comment says to keep Deprecation on the same route.
itens.trecho: panic("middleware.Sunset: sunsetAt must not be zero")

itens.descricao: Responds 404 through the router's not-found handler before the rest of the stack runs when no route matches, using a temporary route context.
itens.motivo: It calls Routes.Match with a fresh chi.NewRouteContext(). If nothing matches, it serves router.NotFoundHandler() and does not call next.

itens.descricao: Detects a terminal with a character-device check on stdout and offers a color-aware writer that the logger and recoverer use for their output.
itens.motivo: IsTTY is set from the stdout Stat() mode, checking ModeDevice and ModeCharDevice. The cW color writer is used in logger.go and recoverer.go.

itens.descricao: Caps in-flight requests across all users rather than limiting per user, with optional backlog and a Retry-After header rounded up to whole seconds.
itens.motivo: Throttle is a global in-flight ceiling made of token channels, not a per-user limiter. It has an optional backlog, and RetryAfterFn output is rounded up to whole seconds.

itens.descricao: Cancels the request context after a timeout and returns 504 Gateway Timeout, relying on handlers to watch ctx.Done() to stop early.
itens.motivo: It wraps the context with context.WithTimeout and, on DeadlineExceeded, writes 504. The handler must watch ctx.Done() to stop early.

itens.descricao: Strips a trailing extension such as .json or .xml from the request path and stores it under URLFormatCtxKey for handlers to read.
itens.motivo: It takes the part after the last '.' in the final path segment as the format, trims it from rctx.RoutePath, and stores it in the context under URLFormatCtxKey.

itens.descricao: Adds a fixed key and value to the request context chain for every request that passes through the middleware, then calls the next handler.
itens.motivo: WithValue wraps the request context with the fixed key and value on every request, then calls next.

itens.descricao: Wraps an http.ResponseWriter to expose the status and bytes written and to tee the body, constructed from a protocol major version argument.
itens.motivo: NewWrapResponseWriter(w, protoMajor) returns a proxy whose interface has Status(), BytesWritten() and Tee(). The protoMajor argument chooses between HTTP/2 and HTTP/1 writer variants.
itens.trecho: func NewWrapResponseWriter(w http.ResponseWriter, protoMajor int) WrapResponseWriter {

itens.descricao: Matches request paths against routes stored in a tree, records URL params, and runs the chained middleware stack before the end handler.
itens.motivo: routeHTTP finds the route in mx.tree and sets URL params. mx.handler is the middleware chain ending in routeHTTP, so middlewares run before the end handler.

itens.descricao: Stores route patterns in a radix tree of static, regexp, param and catch-all nodes, and lets custom HTTP methods be registered through RegisterMethod.
itens.motivo: tree.go defines the node types ntStatic, ntRegexp, ntParam and ntCatchAll, and defines RegisterMethod for adding custom HTTP methods.
